metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace for skills, agents, and tools

plugins.name: marketplace
plugins.description: Marketplace management tools for creating, updating, and validating plugins and marketplace.json entries

plugins.name: ios-view-architecture
plugins.description: iOS SwiftUI view architecture patterns including ViewState, ViewModel, Mapper, loading states, and navigation. Use when building new features or views in a SwiftUI project.

plugins.name: ios-localized-strings
plugins.description: String containers: feature packages take pre-localized copy from the app instead of shipping their own .xcstrings, one small container per surface. Use when a package needs user-facing copy, removing a package catalog, or deciding where a string lives.

plugins.name: ios-package-context
plugins.description: Authoring per-package and per-target CLAUDE.md files for a modularized iOS app — blurb plus file structure, naming, and non-obvious gotchas only, never implementation detail or intention. Use when writing or slimming a package or target CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: react-frontend
plugins.description: React frontend skills — performance best practices, composition patterns, and web design/accessibility guidelines. Use when building or reviewing React components.

plugins.name: node-backend
plugins.description: Node/Express backend skills — TypeScript database layer patterns and Express route handler conventions. Use when building or reviewing backend services.

plugins.name: ios-data-layer
plugins.description: iOS data layer patterns — DTO, domain model, mapper, repository, network service, and AsyncStream store. Use when building or scaffolding a data layer for an iOS feature.

plugins.name: ios-network-layer
plugins.description: Generic iOS NetworkKit package — HTTP client, endpoint protocol, retry policies, bearer auth, and NetworkService. Scaffold script + interactive agent to stamp out and customize the stack.

plugins.name: split-pr
plugins.description: Splits a large changeset or PR into smaller, focused PRs — analyzes symbol-level dependencies between changed files, then creates JIRA subtasks, branches, and parallel or chained PRs as appropriate. Works at any stage: unstaged, staged, committed-but-unpushed, or an existing PR.

plugins.name: swift-modularization
plugins.description: Conventions for structuring a Swift app into SwiftPM packages: infrastructure vs domain clusters, protocol/Live splits, dependency direction, and a thin composition root. Use when organizing modules, adding a feature, or deciding where code lives.

plugins.name: swift-mocking
plugins.description: Using the swift-mocking package (@Mocked macro) to generate protocol mocks for Swift unit tests. Use when mocking protocols, stubbing dependencies, or asserting on invocations in Swift tests.

plugins.name: swift-testing-expert
plugins.description: Expert Swift Testing guidance for test structure, #expect/#require usage, traits and tags, parameterized tests, async waiting patterns, parallel execution, and XCTest migration. Vendored from AvdLee/Swift-Testing-Agent-Skill (MIT).

plugins.name: ios-create-loading-state
plugins.description: Adds FailableLoadingState and LoadingState async-state enums (plus the Nothing type) to a Swift project. Use when creating a loading state or adding async loading enums to an iOS module.

plugins.name: ios-join-async-stream
plugins.description: Combine multiple AsyncStream sources into a single mapped output stream using the combineLatest pattern. Use when joining repository/store streams or merging async sources in Swift.

plugins.name: ios-use-case
plugins.description: Encapsulate business logic as a Sendable struct conforming to a protocol and invoked via callAsFunction(), with the DefaultXxxUseCase naming convention. Use when creating or injecting a use case in Swift.

plugins.name: ios-container
plugins.description: Defines the container pattern — a Sendable holder with no functions and mutable state behind a Mutex, holding a domain's scope-lived in-memory state (a store/cache or a live subscription). Use when creating a container, deciding where to hold in-memory state, or choosing between holding state versus composing a stateless dependency on access.

plugins.name: ios-composition
plugins.description: Compose the dependency graph and infer the navigation tree in the main app using stateless enum composers, from feature containers, app sessions, and local state — packages defer composition and navigation upward. Composition is wiring + navigation only: no logic, analytics, or network calls. Use when wiring a feature's dependencies into the app or deciding where the navigation tree lives.

plugins.name: ios-feature-builder
plugins.description: Plan-only orchestrator for building a new iOS feature end-to-end. Walks an approval-gated, ordered flow — modularization, view architecture, data layer, use cases, container, composition — and delegates each step to its specialist skill, ending in a comprehensive handoff plan. Use when starting a brand-new iOS feature and you want a reviewed plan before any code is written.

plugins.name: core-data-expert
plugins.description: Expert Core Data guidance — stack setup, fetch optimization, threading with NSManagedObjectID, Swift Concurrency, batch operations, persistent history, schema migration, performance, and NSPersistentCloudKitContainer integration. Use when building or debugging a Core Data stack on iOS/macOS. Vendored from AvdLee/Core-Data-Agent-Skill (MIT).

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document so a fresh agent can continue the work — saved to the OS temp dir, with a suggested-skills section, and referencing existing artifacts by path instead of duplicating them. Use when ending a session or transferring work to another agent. Vendored from mattpocock/skills (MIT).
